data.description: 【调月莉音 · 私人泳池边的缜密思考】盛夏微风吹拂的私人泳池畔，莉音身着性感的黑色连体泳衣外搭半透明轻纱，优雅地站在池边俯视着清澈的池水。红瞳微眯——「水温 26 度，风速 1.2 米……一切都是最适合消夏的数值。老师，过来和我一起游两圈吧。」
data.promptProse: Rio stands beside the private pool in her black one-piece swimsuit with red trim and sheer black cover-up, studying the clear water with narrowed red eyes. The slightly low medium view keeps the pool coping beside her and the water surface extending behind. Summer sunlight catches her dark hair and the cover-up's moving edge, with reflected pool light breaking gently across the shaded fabric near her hand.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 私人泳池边的缜密思考
